Only for Tayeba

A message from me to you

Assalamu Alaikum Tayeba,

Asha kori afne ar afnar ghoror shobai bhalo asoin, shukhe asoin. Moi-o bhalo asi.

Moi bhablam, jokhon moi oikhane giya afnare gift dite partam na, teile emon kisuta kori, zeta gift-or thakio beshi special oibo.

Moi emon reels onek dekhsi, zekhane manush tader pochonder manushore ei rokom bhabe birthday wish kore. Moi age kokhono kaure ei bhabe birthday wish kori nai, ar moi janitam-o na eishob kemne kora lage.

Website bana, design kora ar publish kora—eishobor kunuta-o moi jantam na. Eishob moi nije nije shiksi.

Eishob banaite mor pura bish din lagse. Moi November-or panch tarikhe kaam shuru korsi ar November-or pochish tarikhe eita shesh form disi.

Khali mor dua, Mamun bhai jeno raji oin ar afnare eishob dekhar ar porar onumoti dein. Jodi emon oiye, taile moi onek khushi oimu.

Eitar bodole moi afnar kachor thaki kunu kichu asha kortasi na. Khali afne eishob dekhen ar poren, mor lagi eitai onek.

Memory section-or oi dui ta chobi:

Prothom chobir bepare afne to janoin, oita mor WhatsApp profile picture asil, ase, ar shob shomoy thakbo.

Ditiyo chobir lagi maf chai. Moi afnar onumoti charai oita locket banai felsi, kintu mor ar kunu upay-o asil na. Mane, afnare jiggesh-o ba kemne kortam?

Mor afnar gola khub mone pore, kintu moi ar kichu korte pari na, shudhu shobor kora chara.

Muhammad Abdullah
